steps.note: Milk is heated over a gentle flame until it foams.
The fermented milk is stirred into the foaming milk.
The curds are wrapped and pressed under a stone.

sources.text: The four steps, from this page, which gives no temperatures, amounts or times; it says fresh milk, or milk left over from making oerom, so skimmed milk is only one of its starting points.
